notes: No misstatements found. One thing for a human to check in /examples/2: it sets statusSlot but leaves out the status prop. The evidence says "With statusSlot, the default aria-label still says the status prop", and status defaults to 'Expired'. So this static bubble would be named "Paid to Priya Sharma • Expired" even though it shows Paid. Consider adding status="Paid" (or an accessibilityLabel) to the example. Also, /facts/props/3 generalises one measured case ("Declined · 21 October 2026, 4:15 pm" in 231 px) to long status lines in general, which seems a reasonable reading.
